tagline: Local network par IP address ko MAC address mein badalna.
description: IP addresses batate hain ki packet kahan jaana chahiye, lekin Ethernet sirf MAC addresses tak deliver kar sakta hai. ARP yeh gap bharta hai: ek device LAN par sabko awaaz lagata hai “yeh IP kiske paas hai?”, maalik apne MAC se jawab deta hai, aur jawab cache ho jata hai. ARP har jawab par bharosa karta hai, aur attackers isi ka fayda uthate hain.

normal.name: Router ka MAC dhoondhna
normal.summary: Laptop poochta hai 192.168.1.1 kiske paas hai, router jawab deta hai, aur result cache ho jata hai.

steps.title: 192.168.1.1 kiske paas hai?
steps.detail: Laptop apne gateway, 192.168.1.1, ke through packet bhejna chahta hai, lekin uska MAC address nahi jaanta. Woh ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff ko ARP request broadcast karta hai. Switch ise har port par copy karta hai, isliye printer ko bhi milti hai. Target MAC field poora zeros hai kyunki wahi toh unknown hai.

quiz.why: Broadcast same Layer 2 network ke har device ko jata hai. Routers ise forward nahi karte, isliye yeh LAN se bahar nahi jata.

steps.title: Main hoon, yeh raha mera MAC
steps.detail: Printer dekhta hai ki request uske IP ke liye nahi hai aur use ignore kar deta hai. Router apna address pehchanta hai aur laptop ke MAC ko seedha ARP reply bhejta hai: 192.168.1.1 is at b0:be:76:12:4c:01.

steps.title: Cache karo aur bhejo
steps.desc: Kuch der ke liye aur sawaal nahi
steps.detail: Laptop 192.168.1.1 → b0:be:76:12:4c:01 ko apne ARP cache mein store karta hai (“arp -a” ya “ip neigh” se dekho). Jo ping wait kar raha tha woh ab turant nikal jata hai. Router ne bhi laptop ka MAC request se hi seekh liya, isliye woh bina poochhe jawab de sakta hai.

quiz.q: Kya router ko ping ka reply dene se pehle apni ARP request bhejni padti hai?
options: Nahi, usne laptop ka MAC request se seekh liya
quiz.why: Har ARP request mein sender ka IP aur MAC hota hai. Target woh pair store kar leta hai, jisse sawaalon ka doosra round bach jata hai.

steps.title: Purani entry ko dobara check karna
steps.detail: Cache entries hamesha nahi chalti, kyunki devices badal sakte hain. Confirmation ke bina lagbhag 30 seconds baad Linux entry ko stale mark karta hai. Agli baar use hone par laptop use broadcast karne ki jagah cached MAC ko seedha ARP request bhejkar check karta hai.
facts: Confirm karo ki entry ab bhi kaam karti hai
Seconds se minutes, OS par depend

steps.title: Gratuitous ARP
steps.desc: Bina poochhe khud ko announce karna
steps.detail: Jab printer reboot hota hai, woh apne hi address ke liye ARP broadcast karta hai. Kisi ne poocha nahi; maksad hai sabke cache ko refresh karna aur check karna ki 192.168.1.50 koi aur use nahi kar raha. Jo devices printer ko pehle se jaante hain woh apni entry update kar dete hain. Yeh yaad rakhna: koi bhi bina poochhe ARP bhej sakta hai.

quiz.q: Ek device ko aisa ARP reply milta hai jo usne maanga hi nahi. Aam OS kya karta hai?
options: Drop kar deta hai, maanga nahi gaya tha
Agar woh IP pehle se cache mein hai to cache update kar deta hai
quiz.why: ARP mein na authentication hai na request tracking, isliye hosts un addresses ke bina maange jawab bhi maan lete hain jinhe woh jaante hain. Yahi kamzori ARP spoofing use karta hai.

outro.title: IP se MAC, solve
outro.text: Ek broadcast sawaal aur ek seedhe jawab ne laptop ko router ka MAC de diya, aur dono sides ne result cache kar liya. ARP simple aur tez hai, lekin jo sunta hai us par yakeen kar leta hai.

spoofing.name: ARP spoofing aur Dynamic ARP Inspection
spoofing.summary: LAN par attacker router banne ka daava karta hai taaki beech mein baith sake; switch forged ARP drop karna seekh leta hai.

steps.title: Laptop se jhooth bolo
steps.detail: Attacker, usi switch mein plugged, laptop ko aisa ARP reply bhejta hai jo kisi ne maanga nahi: router ka IP attacker ke MAC par hai. Laptop apni cache entry overwrite kar deta hai. arpspoof jaise tools yeh har do second dohrate hain taaki jhooth tika rahe.

steps.title: Router se jhooth bolo
steps.detail: Woh router ke saath bhi yahi karta hai, laptop ke IP ka daava karke. Ab har side maanti hai ki attacker ka MAC doosre ka hai. Dono directions ka traffic attacker ke frame mein jayega.

quiz.q: Laptop ab internet ko packet bhejta hai. Ethernet destination mein kaunsa MAC hai?
quiz.why: Laptop zehreele cache mein apna gateway dhoondhta hai aur use attacker ka MAC milta hai. IP header ab bhi web server hi kehta hai.

steps.title: Man in the middle
steps.desc: Har frame attacker se guzarta hai
steps.detail: Laptop plain HTTP par login form post karta hai. Frame attacker ke paas jata hai, jo use padhta hai aur asli router ko forward kar deta hai taaki kuch toota hua na dikhe. IP addresses kabhi nahi badalte; sirf MAC addresses jhooth bolte hain.

steps.title: Dynamic ARP Inspection
steps.desc: Switch har ARP check karta hai
steps.detail: Network admin switch par DHCP snooping aur Dynamic ARP Inspection on karta hai. Switch ko DHCP se pehle se pata hai ki kaunsa IP aur MAC kaunsi port par hona chahiye. Attacker ki port 192.168.1.66 se bound hai, isliye us port se 192.168.1.1 ka daava karne wala ARP drop aur log ho jata hai.
facts: Sender IP + MAC vs DHCP bindings

quiz.q: Switch ko kaise pata chalta hai ki ARP forged hai?
options: Woh router ko ping karta hai
Uski DHCP snooping table kehti hai ki us port par 192.168.1.66 hai, 192.168.1.1 nahi
Forged ARPs par special flag hota hai
quiz.why: DAI har ARP ke sender IP aur MAC ko un bindings se compare karta hai jo DHCP snooping ne har port ke liye record ki. Mismatch ka matlab jhooth.

steps.title: Wapas normal
steps.desc: Asli ARP cache ko theek karta hai
steps.detail: Laptop ki entry jaldi hi time out ho jati hai ya asli router ke reply se refresh ho jati hai, aur traffic phir seedha router ko jata hai. Smart switches ke bina chhote networks gateway ke liye static ARP entry laga sakte hain. Aur HTTPS beech mein bhi password ko secret rakhta.

outro.title: Jhooth switch par roka gaya
outro.text: ARP spoofing isliye chalta hai kyunki ARP har jawab maan leta hai, bina maange hue bhi. Dynamic ARP Inspection har ARP ko DHCP ke diye hue se check karta hai, aur static entries ya encryption attacker ka fayda cheen lete hain.

cheatsheet.title: ARP message
items: Request: yeh IP kiske paas hai?
Reply: yeh IP is MAC par hai
Kisse poocha ja raha hai (requests mein MAC zero)

cheatsheet.title: Defences
items: Match na hone wala ARP drop karta hai
Har port par MACs limit karta hai
Beech wale ko bekaar bana deta hai
